title: The List of Worries about the Recital
youtube_title: The List of Worries about the Recital | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Listening all the way through is a gift you can give today.
summary: At a kitchen table before breakfast, chairs close, Mama begins to tell Ilaria about list of recital worries that needed the last one said too. Ilaria wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
